description: This Swift source file defines a final class 'CronJobsStore' that manages cron jobs, scheduling, and event handling within the application. It provides functionalities for starting/stopping scheduled polling, refreshing job lists and run logs, running/removing/enabling jobs, and handling real-time gateway events related to cron jobs.

classes.name: CronJobsStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing cron jobs, their execution states, scheduling, and real-time updates in the app.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes polling and subscription tasks for cron job updates, unless in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels all ongoing polling and event tasks to halt updates.

methods.name: refreshJobs
methods.description: Fetches the current list of cron jobs and status from the gateway.

methods.name: refreshRuns
methods.description: Retrieves recent run entries for a specified job.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Triggers immediate execution of a specified cron job, with optional force.

methods.name: removeJob
methods.description: Removes a specified cron job and refreshes the job list.

methods.name: setJobEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a particular cron job.

methods.name: upsertJob
methods.description: Updates an existing job or inserts a new one depending on the provided ID.

methods.name: handle(push:)
methods.description: Processes incoming gateway push events, filtering for cron-related events.

methods.name: handle(cronEvent:)
methods.description: Handles specific cron execution events to update the UI accordingly.

methods.name: scheduleRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of the cron jobs list.

methods.name: scheduleRunsRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of job run entries.
